structured.answer: The page says to hold the money at Psagot ("הזול") and buy אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125 (number 5112628), ending with about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years — but that's with 10,000 now and 500 a month at an assumed 7%, and the minus signs scared me, so I'd ask my son or the bank before doing anything.
